July 23rd, 2026 – MAHA ACTION ENDORSES LILY TANG WILLIAMS FOR CONGRESS

WEARE, NH — Lily Tang Williams, Republican candidate for Congress in New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District, proudly announced today that she has received the endorsement of MAHA Action, an organization which recognizes the importance of common sense in America’s public health policies.

“I am honored to receive the endorsement of MAHA Action,” said Lily Tang Williams. “It should not be controversial to realize that Americans should all be healthier. Over the last few decades, really disturbing negative trends have emerged as it relates to heart disease, diabetes, and other chronic conditions plaguing Americans. As a mother and someone who escaped Communist China, I believe Americans deserve honest information, medical freedom, government transparency, and the ability to make healthcare decisions without coercion from Washington.”

MAHA Action stated: “MAHA Action is proud to endorse Lily Tang Williams for New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District. We cannot fix America’s chronic disease crisis without fixing the corruption that fuels it. She is committed to ending corruption, increasing transparency, and restoring accountability so government works for the American people instead of special interests.”

“Together with decisive action, we will Make America Healthy Again — it’s so critical to our quality of life as Americans and our strength abroad,” said Williams. “This should not be a partisan issue.”

July 10th, 2026 – ​LILY TANG WILLIAMS EARNS ENDORSEMENT OF REPUBLICAN WOMEN’S CAUCUS FUND

WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams announced today that she has received the endorsement of the Republican Women’s Caucus Fund, adding to the growing coalition of conservative leaders and organizations supporting her campaign to represent New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District.

The Republican Women’s Caucus Fund supports strong conservative Republican women who are committed to defending individual liberty, strengthening families, promoting economic opportunity, and advancing policies that put America first. The organization’s priorities are to advocate for Republican women and their legislative initiatives, amplify their achievements both nationally and locally, and strengthen collaboration among Republican women leaders.

“I am deeply honored to receive the endorsement of the Republican Women’s Caucus Fund,” said Lily Tang Williams. “As someone who escaped communist China in pursuit of the American Dream, I know firsthand how precious our freedoms are. I am running for Congress to defend those freedoms, secure our border, restore fiscal responsibility, protect women’s sports, and ensure our children inherit a country that remains the greatest beacon of liberty in the world. I am grateful for the confidence the Republican Women’s Caucus Fund has placed in our campaign.”

“Lily escaped Communist China in pursuit of the American Dream and has dedicated her life to defending freedom, the Constitution, and the liberties that make America exceptional,” said Congresswoman Kat Cammack, Republican Women’s Caucus Fund Chair. “The RWCF is proud to endorse her.”

June 3rd 2026 – LILY TANG WILLIAMS EARNS ENDORSEMENT FROM GUN OWNERS OF AMERICA

WEARE, N.H. — Republican congressional candidate Lily Tang Williams today announced that she has received the endorsement of Gun Owners of America (GOA), one of the nation’s leading grassroots Second Amendment organizations. Gun Owners of America endorsed Williams based on her unwavering commitment to defending Granite Staters’ Second Amendment rights.

“I truly am honored to receive the endorsement of Gun Owners of America,” said Lily Tang Williams. “As someone who grew up under communism, I understand firsthand that the right to self-defense is a fundamental safeguard of liberty.”

Gun Owners of America praised Williams’ commitment to supporting policies that defend the rights of responsible firearm owners. Throughout her campaign, Williams has emphasized individual liberty, limited government, and strict adherence to the Constitution. GOA stated: “Lily earned GOA’s support because she will oppose any new gun control laws and will work to roll back unconstitutional gun laws already on the books… [She] understands we don’t need politicians or government bureaucrats to control every aspect of our lives, including our ability to protect ourselves and our families.”

“New Hampshire has a proud tradition of freedom and self-reliance,” Williams added. “From populated to rural parts of the Second District, people understand that the Second Amendment maintains our cherished Live Free or Die spirit.”

Gun Owners of America represents millions of gun owners nationwide and has long been recognized as one of the most influential organizations advocating for the protection of Second Amendment rights.

April 13th, 2026 – New Hampshire Business and Political Leaders Endorse Lily Tang Williams

Lily Tang Williams, Republican candidate for the U.S. House of Representatives in New Hampshire’s 2nd district, is pleased to announce her 2026 campaign endorsements from the following prominent New Hampshire business and community leaders.

Building on the strong foundation of support from the 64 current and former Republican New Hampshire State Legislators who endorsed her campaign last October, these new endorsements reflect the growing momentum behind Lily Tang Williams’ campaign as she builds the support needed to win the Republican nomination and secure victory in the general election this November.

“I am honored to receive these endorsements for my campaign. I want to thank these successful entrepreneurs and leaders for their support and trust in me to represent the Granite State in Washington DC. With this broad coalition of backing from state legislators and the business community, we are building unstoppable momentum to win the nomination and deliver a Republican victory in the general election—fighting for lower costs, stronger borders, and economic freedom for New Hampshire families.”

NH-02 Republican Nominee Lily Tang Williams Endorsed by New Hampshire Governor Chris Sununu – September 24, 2024

Lily Tang Williams, the Republican Nominee for New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District, today announced the endorsement of New Hampshire Governor Chris Sununu. 

“I’m excited to endorse Lily Tang Williams for Congress,” said Governor Chris Sununu. “Hers is an inspiring story – fleeing Communist China for freedom and opportunity in America. In Congress, Lily will be a principled voice and vote to protect our freedoms, secure the borders and stop the flow of illegal drugs, and tackle the high cost of living. Her passion for making all our lives better is without equal. Lily will help deliver the strong, new leadership our country needs and I urge everyone to vote for her.”

“I am honored to receive the endorsement of my beloved home state Governor,” said Lily Tang Williams, Republican Nominee for New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District. ” I admire how Governor Sununu has led our state, especially his commitment to free market principles, fiscal responsibility, and our Live Free or Die values. He puts the best interests of Granite Staters first and foremost, a quality I hope to emulate as your next Congresswoman.”

The endorsement of one of the most popular Governors in the nation comes on the heels of several other high profile endorsements of Lily’s campaign for Congress, including Congresswoman Elise Stefanik and Protect Freedom PAC. 

Lily has also earned the endorsement of 53 members of the New Hampshire state legislature, Gun Owners of America, US Parents Involved in Education, the New Hampshire Conservative Majority Project, and more. Find a full list of campaign endorsements on her website. 

About Lily Tang Williams
Lily Tang Williams, born and raised in the Peoples Republic of China, a survivor of Mao’s Cultural Revolution, came to the U.S. legally at age of 23 with only $100 in search of freedom and opportunity. Through hard work and the support of her new community, Lily overcame her language and cultural barriers and financial obstacles, going on to earn a Master’s degree in Social Work and eventually starting her own business. Lily is living the American Dream. She is a mother of three adult children, a self-employed small businesswoman, and the 2024 Republican nominee for Congress in New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District. Lily’s campaign slogan is “KEEP THE AMERICAN DREAM ALIVE.”

NH-02 Republican Nominee Lily Tang Williams Endorsed by Congresswoman Elise Stefanik – September 20, 2024

Lily Tang Williams, the Republican Nominee for New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District, today announced that Congresswoman Elise Stefanik (R-NY) endorsed her campaign for Congress.

“Lily Tang Williams fled Communist China to be free,” said Congresswoman Elise Stefanik (R-NY). “She is the embodiment of the American dream, and will be an important voice in Congress to fight back against socialism. I am proud to endorse Lily’s campaign to flip New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District.”

“I am humbled to earn Congresswoman Elise Stefanik’s endorsement,” said Lily Tang Williams, Republican Nominee for New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District. “Congresswoman Stefanik is a strong conservative leader who has passionately fought to protect freedom of religion and speech in our country. Congresswoman Stefanik’s endorsement comes after her PAC, Elevate PAC, endorsed Lily earlier this week. Elevate PAC is working to increase the number of Republican women elected to Congress

MAGGIE’S LIST PROUDLY ENDORSES LILY TANG WILLIAMS FOR CONGRESS IN NH-02 – September 20, 2024

Washington, D.C. — Maggie’s List, a federal political action committee (PAC) dedicated to electing fiscally conservative women to office, is proud to announce the endorsement of Lily Tang Williams for New Hampshire’s 2nd Congressional District.

“Lily Tang Williams understands the importance of entering America legally and the value of our individual freedoms as exemplified by New Hampshire’s motto ‘Live Free or Die’.   Growing up under communism in China, Lily understands China’s threat to our economy and our national security and will work in Washington to protect our country and New Hampshire,” said Maggie’s List New Hampshire Chairman Jan Face Glassman.

“I am honored to receive the endorsement of Maggie’s List. Only in America could I go from being an escapee of Communist China, arriving in this nation with $100 in my pocket and knowing very little English, to being the nominee for Congress in New Hampshire’s Second Congressional District. In Congress, I will be a fierce defender of the American Dream, fight to bring down the unprecedented inflation and the cost of living, secure our borders, and put the American people first,” said candidate Lily Tang Williams.
